summary: Digest-bound handoff/replay is modeled after SLSA/in-toto subject attestation discipline. HF snapshot materialization remains path-flexible but revision-locked; selector receipt replay must therefore verify subject digests, not path labels.

sources.finding: SLSA provenance is an attestation over artifacts produced by a build definition; subjects and digests are the core trust primitive.
In-toto statements bind predicates to one or more supply-chain subjects; the rev0110 selector replay gate mirrors this predicate-over-subject pattern.
snapshot_download can use cache_dir/local_dir and exact revisions; local movement must not weaken reviewed model/snapshot identity.

applied_changes: selector receipt replay gate verifies moved/renamed receipts by subject digest
relocation audit fixture negative cases now write fixture receipts instead of overwriting the current default selector receipt
readiness gate includes selector receipt replay before downstream selector/cost evaluation
